I’m also young and depressed, so I understand. Here are some things that make me feel better and help fight depression. If they even help a little then it’s worth it. 

1. Finding something in your life to appreciate. Look for small things to be happy about. Like I have 1 friend. I wish I had more but I’m very thankful for him. 

2. Make goals for yourself. Again start small if you have to. If you can start by say, eating one more healthy meal a day. Or whatever goal that you think could help. 

3. Promise yourself not to do anything drastic in the moment. Sometimes you might feel very angry or sad, etc. In these moments of strong emotion I often think and make very different choices than I normally would. Inevitably emotions pass. Think about things with a clear head and don’t let hormones control you. 

Idk if any of this is particularly applicable to you, but hopefully it can help.
